prompt: Summarize continuous integration pipelines. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 1: Do not use any numbers or digits. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 2: Exactly 5 sentences. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 3: Every sentence must end with an exclamation mark (!).
evaluation_criteria:
Digit Exclusion: 0-5 (Evaluates zero numbers)
Sentence Count And Punctuation: 0-5 (Evaluates 5 sentences ending with !)
response_text:
Continuous integration pipelines automate the process of merging code changes to detect issues early and ensure smooth collaboration!

They integrate code updates frequently to catch errors before they escalate into larger problems!

Automated testing runs on every submission to validate functionality and maintain code quality!

Developers receive immediate feedback, allowing them to fix mistakes right away without delays!

This streamlined workflow keeps projects stable and reduces the risk of costly errors later on!
